content.text: Kumwail patohdo, kitail kapinga KAUN-O!
Kitail ngisingiski atail peren ong Koht me kin ketin sinsilei kitail!
Kitail patohwanlahng atail kapingkalahngan mwohn silangi
oh pereperen kokoulki koulen kaping.
Pwe KAUN-O, iei Koht manaman emen,
nanmwarki manaman emen me kin ketiket pohnangin koht akan koaros.
E kin ketin kakaun sampah pokon,
sang pahn kepin sampah lellahng pohn kumwen nahna kan.
E kin ketin kaunda madau me e ketin wiahda,
iangahki sahpw koaros me pein ih ketin kapikada.
Kumwail patohdo, kitail poaridi oh pwongih Koht;
kitail kelehpwikihdi mwohn KAUN-O, me ketin wieikitailda!
Pwe ih me atail Koht;
kitail sapwellime aramas me e kin ketin apwahpwalih,
sapwellime pelin sihpw me e kin ketin katungoale.
Kumwail rong dahme e mahsanih rahnwet:
“Kumwail dehr keptakaila, duwehte amwail pahpa kahlap ako nan Meripa,
duwen irail rahno nan Massa en sapwtehno.
Mehnda ma re kilangehr ei doadoahk manaman akan rehrail,
a re kasongosongieier wasao.
Erein pahr pahisek I wie nsensuwed pahn aramas pwuko.
I ahpw nda, ‘Ia uwen arail soaloalopwoat!
Re kahng kapwaiada ei kosonned akan.’
I ahpw lingeringerkihda oh inoukihda ni kehlail,
‘Kumwail sohte mwahn pahn pedolong nan sahpwo
wasa me I men kommoaleikumwaildiong ie.’”
